title: GATE CSE Complete Core & Engineering Mathematics

topics.subject: DBMS
topics.title: ER Model & Relational Algebra
topics.raw_excerpt: Covers conceptual modeling via ER/EER diagrams (strong/weak entities, participation, cardinality ratios) and mapping schemas to relational tables. Relational algebra operators (select, project, union, set difference, Cartesian product, natural join, division) provide the formal query foundation.

topics.subject: DBMS
topics.title: SQL & Tuple Relational Calculus
topics.raw_excerpt: SQL DDL/DML querying with joins, outer joins, nested IN/ANY/ALL subqueries, aggregation with GROUP BY/HAVING, and SQL three-valued logic (TRUE, FALSE, UNKNOWN) under NULL values, paired with safe Tuple Relational Calculus formulations.

topics.subject: DBMS
topics.title: Normalization & Functional Dependencies
topics.raw_excerpt: Formal schema design using functional dependencies (FDs), Armstrong inference rules, minimal canonical cover, prime vs non-prime attributes, candidate key discovery, lossless-join testing (Heath theorem), and decompositions into 3NF and BCNF.

topics.subject: DBMS
topics.title: Transactions & Concurrency Control
topics.raw_excerpt: Transaction atomicity, isolation, durability, precedence-graph conflict serializability, cascadeless and recoverable schedules, locking protocols (2PL, Strict 2PL), Thomas write rule, and WAL/ARIES crash recovery.

topics.subject: DBMS
topics.title: File Organization & B/B+ Tree Indexing
subtopics: B-Tree & B+ Tree Node Order & Splits
topics.raw_excerpt: Disk block storage, primary/clustering/secondary indexes, B-tree vs B+ tree structural equations for internal order and leaf capacity, sequential leaf scan performance, and dynamic extendible hashing directory doubling.

topics.subject: Operating Systems
topics.title: Processes, Threads & CPU Scheduling
topics.raw_excerpt: Process lifecycle, PCB context switching, POSIX fork() execution trees, shared vs private thread state (stack/registers vs heap), and preemptive/non-preemptive CPU scheduling metrics (turnaround, waiting, response time).

topics.subject: Operating Systems
topics.title: Process Synchronization & Semaphores
topics.raw_excerpt: Race conditions, Mutual Exclusion, Progress, and Bounded Waiting criteria; hardware atomic primitives (TestAndSet, CompareAndSwap), semaphore wait/signal invariants, and deadlock/starvation pitfalls in classic synchronization problems.

topics.subject: Operating Systems
topics.title: Deadlocks & Resource Allocation
topics.raw_excerpt: Analysis of Mutual Exclusion, Hold-and-Wait, No Preemption, and Circular Wait; cycle detection in single vs multi-instance RAGs; worst-case pigeonhole deadlock-free resource bounds; and Banker's algorithm safety sequence verification.

topics.subject: Operating Systems
topics.title: Memory Management & Paging
topics.raw_excerpt: Logical-to-physical address translation, elimination of external fragmentation via paging, TLB hit-ratio EMAT calculations, multi-level page table sizing, and inverted page tables indexed by physical frame.

topics.subject: Operating Systems
topics.title: Virtual Memory, Page Replacement & File Systems
topics.raw_excerpt: Demand paging, working-set thrashing control, stack vs non-stack replacement algorithms (Belady's anomaly in FIFO vs LRU/OPT), page-fault rate constraints on EMAT, and multi-indirect UNIX inode maximum file capacity.

topics.subject: Computer Networks
topics.title: OSI/TCP-IP & Data Link Framing/CRC
topics.raw_excerpt: Layered network architecture, HDLC bit stuffing, modulo-2 polynomial CRC checksum generation, bandwidth-delay product, and utilization/sequence-width formulas for Stop-and-Wait, Go-Back-N (2^k - 1), and Selective Repeat (2^(k-1)).

topics.subject: Computer Networks
topics.title: MAC Protocols, CSMA/CD & Ethernet Switching
subtopics: CSMA/CD Collision Detection & Min Frame Size
topics.raw_excerpt: Random-access MAC protocols (ALOHA throughput 18.4%/36.8%), Ethernet CSMA/CD minimum frame length constraint L >= BW * RTT, exponential backoff bounds, and separating collision vs broadcast domains across hubs, switches, and routers.

topics.subject: Computer Networks
topics.title: IPv4 Addressing, Subnetting & CIDR
topics.raw_excerpt: IPv4 header fields, CIDR subnet masks, usable host counts, non-overlapping VLSM allocation, supernet route summarization, router longest-prefix matching, and 8-byte aligned IP fragmentation offsets across MTU boundaries.

topics.subject: Computer Networks
topics.title: Routing Protocols — RIP, OSPF & BGP
topics.raw_excerpt: Intra-AS and inter-AS routing protocols: Bellman-Ford distance vector updates, count-to-infinity mitigations (Split Horizon / Poison Reverse), OSPF link-state flooding and Dijkstra SPF, and BGP AS-PATH loop prevention.

topics.subject: Computer Networks
topics.title: Transport Layer — TCP Congestion Control & UDP
topics.raw_excerpt: Connection-oriented reliable transport vs connectionless UDP, sliding-window flight cap min(rwnd, cwnd), TCP Reno response to 3 duplicate ACKs vs timeouts, Slow Start exponential doubling, AIMD linear growth, and 32-bit sequence wraparound.

topics.subject: Theory of Computation
topics.title: Deterministic & Non-Deterministic Finite Automata
topics.raw_excerpt: Formal DFA/NFA definitions, subset construction (2^n worst-case state blowup), product DFA constructions for union/intersection, and Myhill-Nerode distinguishability classes for minimal state counts.

topics.subject: Theory of Computation
topics.title: Regular Expressions & Pumping Lemma
subtopics: Identifying Subtly Regular vs Non-Regular Languages
topics.raw_excerpt: Algebraic equivalences of regular expressions, closure under Boolean and rational operations, and applying the Pumping Lemma carefully as a necessary condition to prove languages non-regular.

topics.subject: Theory of Computation
topics.title: Context-Free Grammars & Pushdown Automata
topics.raw_excerpt: CFGs, ambiguity detection, CNF conversion and derivation length bounds, pushdown automata determinism gap (palindromes), and failure of CFL closure under intersection and complement (unlike DCFL complement closure).

topics.subject: Theory of Computation
topics.title: Turing Machines & Undecidability
topics.raw_excerpt: Church-Turing computability equivalence, recursive vs recursively enumerable characterization (L and complement both RE), undecidability of A_TM / HALT_TM / EQ_CFG, and mapping reduction contrapositives.

topics.subject: Theory of Computation
topics.title: Rice's Theorem & Complexity Basics
topics.raw_excerpt: Applying Rice's theorem strictly to non-trivial semantic properties of L(M) while recognizing decidable bounded/syntactic checks, alongside fundamental P, NP, NP-complete reductions, and co-NP collapse theorems.

topics.subject: Discrete Mathematics
topics.title: Propositional & Predicate Logic
topics.raw_excerpt: Truth tables, tautologies, CNF/DNF, logical inference chains, and precise handling of universal/existential quantifier scope and negation in first-order predicate logic.

topics.subject: Discrete Mathematics
topics.title: Sets, Relations, Partial Orders & Lattices
topics.raw_excerpt: Binary relation properties, counting relations via adjacency matrices, equivalence class partitions (Stirling/Bell numbers), poset extremal elements, and algebraic lattice bounds.

topics.subject: Discrete Mathematics
topics.title: Functions & Counting Combinatorics
topics.raw_excerpt: Counting principles, bijections, onto-function enumeration, multiset combinations with repetition, inclusion-exclusion counting, and derangement recurrences.

topics.subject: Discrete Mathematics
topics.title: Graph Theory — Connectivity, Trees & Planarity
topics.raw_excerpt: Fundamental undirected graph invariants, tree characterizations, Eulerian degree criteria, planar embedding equation V - E + F = 2, bipartite/odd-cycle coloring, and Cayley's n^(n-2) labeled tree count.

topics.subject: Discrete Mathematics
topics.title: Algebraic Structures — Groups & Boolean Algebra
topics.raw_excerpt: Finite group theory (order, cyclic generators, Lagrange divisibility, abelian classification up to isomorphism) and Boolean algebra laws including self-dual function enumeration.

topics.subject: Linear Algebra
topics.title: Matrices, Determinants & Rank
topics.raw_excerpt: Core matrix invariants: determinant multilinear scaling, rank bounds on sums and products (Sylvester inequality), trace-rank relations for projection/idempotent matrices, and odd-order skew-symmetric determinants.

topics.subject: Linear Algebra
topics.title: Systems of Linear Equations
subtopics: Parametric Infinite vs No Solution Cases
topics.raw_excerpt: Augmented matrix rank testing for existence and uniqueness of Ax = b, homogeneous solution space dimensionality via Rank-Nullity, and full-rank invertibility implications.

topics.subject: Linear Algebra
topics.title: Vector Spaces, Basis & Dimension
topics.raw_excerpt: Abstract vector spaces over R, basis tests via determinants, fundamental subspace orthogonality (NullSpace perp RowSpace), Grassmann intersection formula, and orthogonal projection matrices.

topics.subject: Linear Algebra
topics.title: Eigenvalues, Eigenvectors & Diagonalization
topics.raw_excerpt: Characteristic polynomials, eigenvalue transformations for A^k + cI, real symmetric orthogonal diagonalizability, defective non-diagonalizable Jordan blocks (AM > GM), and Cayley-Hamilton inverse derivation.

topics.subject: Linear Algebra
topics.title: LU Decomposition & Positive Definite Matrices
topics.raw_excerpt: Gaussian elimination without pivoting via non-zero leading minors, symmetric positive-definiteness via positive eigenvalues or Sylvester minors, Cholesky L*L^T factorization, and O(n^2) back-substitution reuse.

topics.subject: Calculus
topics.title: Limits, Continuity & Differentiability
topics.raw_excerpt: Evaluating 0/0, inf/inf, and 1^inf indeterminate limits via algebraic limits, L'Hopital, and series expansion; distinguishing continuity from differentiability.

topics.subject: Calculus
topics.title: Mean Value Theorems & Maxima/Minima
topics.raw_excerpt: Existence of stationary/mean-value points under Rolle and Lagrange MVTs, bounding function growth via f'(x), counting real roots monotonically, and optimizing on bounded domains.

topics.subject: Calculus
topics.title: Taylor Series & Partial Derivatives
topics.raw_excerpt: Taylor/Maclaurin series expansions (e^x, sin x, cos x), directional derivative maximization along grad(f), Euler's homogeneous theorem, and classifying local extrema vs saddle points via Hessian tests.

topics.subject: Calculus
topics.title: Definite Integrals & Fundamental Theorem
topics.raw_excerpt: Symmetry shortcuts on [-a, a], differentiating integrals with variable limits via Leibniz rule, reflection property f(a-x), and evaluating polynomial-power integrals via Beta/Gamma functions.

topics.subject: Calculus
topics.title: Improper Integrals & Multiple Integrals
topics.raw_excerpt: Convergence at zero and infinity for 1/x^p, Gaussian integral evaluation via polar transformation Jacobian, and exchanging x/y integration bounds on triangular domains.

topics.subject: Probability & Statistics
topics.title: Sample Spaces, Axioms & Conditional Probability
topics.raw_excerpt: Probability axioms, inclusion-exclusion, conditioning sample spaces, sequential dependent draws without replacement, and counterexamples distinguishing pairwise from mutual independence.

topics.subject: Probability & Statistics
topics.title: Bayes Theorem & Total Probability
topics.raw_excerpt: Partitioning sample spaces via Total Probability and inverting conditional likelihoods via Bayes' Theorem to compute posterior beliefs across diagnostic tests, urns, and multi-evidence classification.

topics.subject: Probability & Statistics
topics.title: Random Variables, PMF/PDF & CDF
topics.raw_excerpt: Discrete PMFs and continuous PDFs, computing interval probabilities from CDF differences F(b)-F(a), and deriving transformed distribution PDFs via CDF inversion.

topics.subject: Probability & Statistics
topics.title: Standard Distributions — Binomial, Poisson, Normal, Exponential
topics.raw_excerpt: Moments and physical interpretations of Bernoulli, Binomial, Geometric, Poisson (additive under independence), memoryless Exponential, and Gaussian Normal distributions.

topics.subject: Probability & Statistics
topics.title: Expectation, Variance, Covariance & Central Limit Theorem
topics.raw_excerpt: Expectation linearity without independence, Var(aX+bY) with covariance cross-terms, zero-covariance dependent variables (X, X^2), Chebyshev tail bounds, and CLT sample-mean convergence.
